title: Print OpenRouter request cost per generation

comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
Fixture: print per-request cost from OpenRouter Image API.

The /api/v1/images response embeds usage: { prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost } (verified against openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/image-generation — cost is USD, when available). openrouterImageGen currently parses the response and discards usage.

# Target
- src/asset/gen/box-art.ts: openrouterImageGen factory. log once per call, at the source — no signature changes, no plumbing through callers (covers admin studio AND batch worker).
- One new small test in src/asset/gen/box-art.test.ts asserting the log fires with model/cost from a mocked fetch (Bun spies on console). Assert behavior, not line numbers.

# Change
After successful parse, before returning bytes:
  console.log(`[openrouter] model=${model} cost=$${usage.cost} tokens=${usage.total_tokens}`)
- Skip the line when usage or usage.cost is missing (some providers/routes omit it) — generation must never fail for logging.
- Keep it exactly one log line; no new deps, no other files.

# Acceptance
- mocked generation emits the line with real values from the fixture response
- absent usage -> no log, no throw
- bun test src/asset/gen/box-art.test.ts green; full bun test no NEW failures (3 pre-existing collection-filter failures are known)

# Constraint
No build/lint sweeps. Single commit: "feat: log OpenRouter per-request cost". Flag tk ready-to-review. DO NOT merge; Coach handles merge with user after review.

Worktree: .worktrees/openrouter-cost-log (branch openrouter-cost-log, base bd4b904)
